roles.name: OWNER
roles.description: System owner with unrestricted access. OWNER is protected from modification or deletion.

roles.name: SUPER_ADMIN
roles.description: Platform super administrator with unrestricted feature access, including ML training and model evaluation.

roles.name: ADMIN
roles.description: Application administrator with user, integration, role, and permission management capabilities, excluding super-admin-only ML capabilities.

roles.name: USER
roles.description: Standard operational user with run and schedule capabilities.
